bayts.text: To a Generous, All-Embracing Lord, the best of those worshipped, (goes) my gratitude, at my home, on the sea and in the deserts.
My God is Wise, Beneficent, possessed of grace, Rich and Enriching: His generosity is perpetual generosity.
He repelled all enemies from me and led to me what I aspired to, without toil, constraint or harshness.
To Him my gratitude with heart and body, for ever: He has bestowed on me success, by grace, and right direction.
It has sufficed me, in the two Abodes, that God is for me, with a kindness and a generosity whose outpouring is boundless.
My hope with the Enricher is a hope fulfilled: His servant I have become, and He is my Lord and my Beloved.
Exalted be He, Generous, Enricher, Who led me to Himself with a kindness and generosity vast and beyond counting.
My Beloved, the Bestower (Al-Wahhāb), has erased my love for anything but what He chose for me, in the two Abodes, of every aim.
He chose for me that I be His servant and the servant of the Prophet; and my sowing is that Allah is for me, and He is my harvest.
I shall be His servant and the servant of His servant, and through him He tamed my enemies for me, (leaving me) ungrieved.
Increase the taming (of foes), O Subduer (Al-Qahhār), make victory everlasting and direct good things to me, O best of the One to Whom all turn.
My wealth is my being, with you, his servant, with my heart, my body and my ink, blackening (the pages).
There called me to remembrance and gratitude toward you, through him, wishes fulfilled from you with kindness and the raising to mastery.
You repelled harm from me and led to me what I sought: gratitude is therefore due, with remembrance and careful recitation.
I have resolved upon perpetual gratitude through the verses, serving with writing him whom You set foremost, the best of those born.
My distresses, my burdens and my straits, You dispelled them with kindness, with wondrous wisdom and by bringing forth (outcomes).
You erased from the heart what had afflicted me for long, O Opener (Al-Fattāḥ), O best of those worshipped.
